AP (scraped): Khatam al-Anbiya command warning Thursday via state TV: 'Any failure to comply, deviation from the designated route, or disregard for the navigation protocols of the Islamic Republic of Iran in the Strait of Hormuz will be met with an immediate and forceful response.' US interference 'met with a rapid and decisive reaction'. Doha two-day round ended, no breakthrough; covered Hormuz traffic + unfreezing assets. Qatar FM: next round after Khamenei funeral rites (burial 9 July). Trump: 'The denuclearization of Iran is moving along well... They've had very good meetings, and we'll see.' Lloyd's List: 258 transits last week vs 138 prior. Corroborated: Reuters https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/most-gulf-markets-muted-us-iran-negotiations-show-little-headway-2026-07-02/ (Gulf markets: Saudi -0.3, Qatar -0.8); WSJ oil pre-war levels https://www.wsj.com/finance/commodities-futures/oil-falls-as-supply-increases-amid-easing-mideast-tensions-518c2f51
